content: {"phoneNote":"The hero works, but 'Navodila za pot' appears three times in the first two screens (header, hero, blue info band) and the dark hero photo is almost invisible behind the text.","desktopNote":"Strong bold hero with a readable, relevant photo, but below it the sections are left-stacked in a narrow column, leaving the right half of 'Kje delam', 'Kako poteka delo' and 'Cene' empty.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Remove the duplicate 'Navodila za pot' links (keep one in header, one in the blue address band) and the duplicated phone number in the CTA section near the footer.","Desktop: use the empty right half of 'Kako poteka delo', 'Kje delam' and 'Cene' for a workshop/van photo or a two-column layout; the 'Kje delam' band with two tags is a dead strip.","Phone: lighten the hero overlay or crop the photo so the cylinder/keys are visible behind the headline; shorten the headline so the phone number sits higher on the first screen."],"blockers":[]}
